title: Atari Buried Truckloads of Games. In 2014, Diggers Found Them

scenes.text: Atari buried truckloads of video games in the desert.
In 1983, it dumped unsold cartridges in a New Mexico landfill.
For 30 years, nobody knew if the story was true.
On April 26, 2014, diggers opened a square about 150 feet wide.
After about three hours, the first cartridges came out of the ground.
Hundreds of games, buried in 1983 and dug up like fossils.

description:
Atari buried truckloads of video games in a New Mexico landfill in 1983.
On April 26, 2014, a dig confirmed the story, and hundreds of cartridges came out of the ground.
Which old game would you dig up?
first_comment: What is the oldest game you still own?
